rows.reason: Protocol emulation is firmware on the ISA core, graded by deterministic benches (directed, seeded constrained-random, gate-level) against independent reference models; every rate is a core-cycle count at row 4's clock target.
Stretch aim that binds no number; its entry condition is a deterministic instruction-cycle budget sketch (DR 0011 / DR 0015 hand counts, stated as such).
Instruction cycle latency is fixed by the instruction word and checked by formal properties (no_data_dependent_latency, pin_write_latency); not a sampled quantity.

Timing closure is static timing analysis at the PDK's characterised corners (DR 0007's proposed corner set): a per-corner worst setup/hold slack with a pass/fail reading, on each flow of record (klt flow netlist-estimate stage; LibreLane flow post-route). No distributional term.
A fixed wiring fact of the submission template (pin count per direction), checked by the functional suite instantiating the wrapper as the template defines it.
Program store size and load/boot paths checked by the deterministic load-phase and boot-ROM cocotb benches (fixed edge counts, CRC gate); sizes are word counts.
An upper bound in tiles; evidence is flow-attributed die-area figures and cell counts, deterministic outputs of a fixed netlist. No per-part density or yield term is claimed.
Requirements on benches, cover bins, negative controls, formal properties and independent reference models: deterministic pass/fail checks.
Process row: licence, submission template, and the 2027-01-18 deadline. No measurement of the design.

For each fixed SDF corner and firmware image, the bench measures the time between the start edge and last transition at the TX pin. The 2 % bound uses one programmed bit period as its denominator. Routed rise and fall delays can differ by picoseconds even when the program waits a whole number of cycles. The three corners and two payloads per image are directed cases. RX rate offsets are also fixed stimuli. These checks make no claim about the distribution of clock jitter or part-to-part variation.

Fixed instruction-cost ratios (f_clk/4 for transfers that take the sample without keeping it, f_clk/10 for keeping transfers) plus four fixed mode configurations, decoded byte-exact by the reference model.

Bus phase minimums (t_LOW, t_HIGH, t_HD;STA, t_SU;STA, t_SU;STO) met as core-cycle counts against the I2C specification's minimums, with a bounded SCL period per grade; pacing is fixed by the committed firmware images and graded cycle by cycle.
